checks.description: E01.A4 For every output and admissibility row of P1–P4 at their solved states: `|twin − reference| ≤ 1e-13 · max(1, |reference|)`.

E01.A5 Gradient oracle. Central differences on the float path with `h_j = 1e-6 · max(|x_j|, S_x,j)` (and likewise for continuous θ, with `S_x,j` replaced by `max(|θ|, 1)`): `|∂y/∂x_j − FD| ≤ 1e-6 · max(|∂y/∂x_j|, |y|/S_x,j) + 1e-12/S_x,j`. This is checked for every stored nonzero and for 20 seeded structural zeros.
E01.A6 `select` twice at one state gives identical signatures. Evaluation with the held regime at its selection state is bitwise equal to evaluation after selection.
E01.A7 Every admissibility row is ≥ 0 at its selection state. At `S = 2·S_max` exactly, `units:2` is selected.
E01.A8 Compiling P1–P4 with every continuous θ symbolic raises nothing. Requesting a structural θ symbolic gives `ASSESSMENT_PARAMETER_STRUCTURAL`.
E01.A9 Underwood: - `ΔT₁ = ΔT₂ = 10 K` → 10 K within 4 ulp; - ratio 10: `ΔT_lm/LMTD − 1 = 3.801e-3 ± 1e-6`; - ratio 50: `2.5592e-2 ± 1e-6`.

E01.A10 Exchanger hand case: `Q = 1.0e6 W`, `U = 500`, `F_T = 1`, isothermal steam at 433.15 K, process 300 → 400 K. Expected `ΔT_lm = 71.95947205233731 K` and `area = 27.79342236620868 m²` (rel 1e-13). The deviation from the exact LMTD of 71.92001136510889 K is reported as +5.4867e-4.
E01.A11 Drum: B4's hand case on P1's flash (inputs: the recorded V̇_L, V̇_V, ρ_L, ρ_V). D, L, V and the controlling member match (rel 1e-12).
E01.A12 Column: B4's hand case on P3 (stage vapour and liquid states recorded). Every `D_j²`, j*, D and H match (rel 1e-12).
E01.A13 `VolumetricFlowBlock` values and derivatives are bitwise equal to `n·v` and to the provider's derivatives at the same state, for every provider in P1–P3.
E01.A14 Every SSLW entry used by P1–P3: our value vs B4's mpmath value at the 3 registered sizes and at the P-sizes, rel ≤ 1e-10.
E01.A15 The same cases vs the IDAES evaluation, rel ≤ 1e-9. A larger difference is escalated to the design lane, never loosened.
E01.A16 Escalation with target = base year and currency gives a factor of exactly 1.0. A base → target → base round trip is within 2 ulp.
E01.A17 `S = 2.5·S_max` → `units:3` and `C_P = 3·C_P1(S/3)`, bitwise equal to the formula.
E01.A18 `S = 0.5·S_min` → `floor`, `C_P = C_P1(S_min)`, and `∂C_P/∂x ≡ 0` (an empty row).
E01.A19 Quote: `C = cost·E` bitwise. With an exponent: `cost·E·(S/S_q)^n` (rel 1e-15).
E01.A20 `ebtf-prisma-v1`: `capex.total/capex.TDC = 1.744314` within 4 ulp.
E01.A22 `tac` equals `CRF·capex.total + opex.total` computed independently from the report's own fields (rel 1e-15).
E01.A23 The AACE class is the maximum over items, and the ranges equal §4.9's table. One extrapolated item → class `none`.
E01.A24 `build_unit_score_table` on `test-background-v1` reproduces `q_E, q_H, q_X` of §4.8.5, rel ≤ 1e-12.

E01.A25 P4: our `impact.climate_change_test.rate` vs Brightway's `foreground_check` on the same exchange amounts, rel ≤ 1e-10. It also matches WO-A5's hand superposition (`benchmarks/e01/lca_hand/`), rel ≤ 1e-12.
E01.A26 Doubling every inventory amount doubles `h` bitwise. `∂h/∂x` equals the hand-assembled `Σ_k q_k α_k ∂φ_k/∂x` bitwise.
E01.A27 1 kg/s CH4 fossil to air gives exactly 29.8 kg CO2-eq/s with `gwp100-ipcc-ar6-v1`.
E01.A28 An assessment using a `redistribution: forbidden` table yields a report and bundle export containing that table's id and sha256 and none of its scores (byte search).
E01.A29 Without `bw2data`/`bw2calc` importable, P4 evaluates from its tables and every adapter call returns `UNSUPPORTED(LCA_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE)`.
E01.A30 P1: `d tac/d p` and `d impact/d p` for 2 pinned inputs (a heater outlet T, a pump outlet P), via the wrapper, vs central differences of certified re-solves (step `1e-4·s_p`): rel ≤ 1e-5.
E01.A31 Forward and adjoint modes agree, rel ≤ 1e-10.
E01.A32 A request with no assessment output never calls the wrapper. Its result is bitwise equal to the direct `evaluate_sensitivity`.

E01.A33 P2 with objective `1/|tac(x₀)| · assessment:tac`, from 2 starts. The candidate passes V1–V7. `tac` at `x_sim` agrees with the optimizer's output within 1e-6 relative, and `tac(candidate) ≤ tac(start)`. *Erratum 2026-10-29 (orchestrator ruling on ESC-I1, `docs/E01B_DECISIONS.md`):* `tac(candidate) ≤ tac(start)` is judged over the feasible starts only — a start is feasible when the formulation's constraints hold within their stated tolerance there (box exactly, inequality slack ≥ −τ_feas, V3's rule). M03's starts 0 and 1 violate `recovery_A ≥ 0` (−0.0159, −0.0537) and sit below the constrained optimum's `tac`; they are reported with their violations, not compared.
E01.A34 The gray-box output Jacobian pattern never changes during A33's runs and equals the twin's structural pattern.
E01.A35 With `assessment=None`, `output_names() == []`, and the Pyomo model's component list equals that of `main`.
E01.A36 A constructed P2 variant whose dormant stream becomes active at `x_sim` gives V7 `ASSESSMENT_REGIME_CHANGED` and `NOT_VERIFIED`.
E01.A37 Naming an assessment output for a TR study → `UNSUPPORTED(ASSESSMENT_OUTPUT_IN_TRF)` before any solve.

E01.A38 Fixtures emitted by real runs validate against the new schemas. Every existing `study` and `optimization-report` fixture validates unchanged against the widened schemas. The registry lists both new files.
E01.A39 Two evaluations give byte-identical canonical reports (excluding `provenance`).

E01.A40 One refused item: dependent totals are `null` and status is `PARTIAL`. With `exclude`, the totals return and the exclusion is listed. A study naming a `null` output → `ASSESSMENT_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE`.
E01.A41 Every default used is in `defaulted_inputs`. The test enumerates `defaults.py` against P1–P3's reports.
E01.A42 Every new dependency and data file has a D04 entry with licence text and sha256. The checker script exits non-zero otherwise.

E01.A43 (links). - `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python scripts/t08_numerical_policy.py --check` exits 0 and prints `equals`, with v2's sha256 unchanged (`6b449911…d707c`). - E01's `exact_sha256` is exactly `[assessment_sha256, regime_sha256]`, and it does not intersect `schema_sha256_names()` (v2's domain). - These pass: `test_m04_numerical_policy.py::test_a37_…`, `test_m02_schemas.py::test_g1_…` and the two `test_t08_adr0025.py` A1 tests. - Every existing study and optimization-report fixture validates. A study carrying `assessment` validates; one with an extra key inside `assessment` fails.

E01.A44 (forms). - Exchanger. F_P at p ≤ 100 psig equals 1.0 bitwise, and its ∂/∂P row is structurally empty. At p = 2000·(1 + 1e-9) psig the item is refused `CORRELATION_OUT_OF_RANGE(‹item›.pressure)`. `CarbonSteelCarbonSteel` gives F_M == 1.0. - Trays. F_NT(10) = 1.4997082643358985 and F_NT(19) = 1.0409949546984238, each within rel 1e-15. F_NT(20) == F_NT(21) == 1.0. - Vessel hand case (vertical, `weight_limit` "1", CarbonSteel; D = 1 m, L = 3 m, t = 0.03175 m): - W = 6777.48970680199 lb (rel 1e-13); - C_v = 33222.512431689356 (rel 1e-12); - C_PL = 5045.446066094272 (L floored at 12 ft, D in range; rel 1e-12); - C_P1 = 38267.95849778363 at CE 500 (rel 1e-12). - CE 394 conversion. r == 500.0/394.0 == 1.2690355329949239. - Drives. η_m(1 hp) == 0.8, and η_m(10 hp) = 0.8638030099054395 (rel 1e-15). A compressor's `‹U›.drive` capital == 0.0, with provenance `included_in`, and its electricity = W/η_m(W/N) (rel 1e-15).

E01.A45 (loader). The loader refuses each of these, built in the test and never shipped: - a set missing a `source_line`; - a `primary` source without `verified`; - a `floor` on a decreasing form; - an unknown option choice; - non-contiguous pieces.

E01.A46 (volumes). - The §9.4 guards hold. - P2's drum is sized, with `v_source = model_identity` on both products. - P3's shell and trays are sized from the declared volumes. - For the new rows, twin = reference ≤ 1e-13, and A5's finite-difference oracle holds.

E01.A47 (ESC-A4). - Kinetic CSTR: V = τ_R·V̇_out against a hand value (rel 1e-14). Without τ it is refused `SIZING_INPUT_MISSING(‹U›.vessel.residence_time_s)`, and the duty item remains. - Drum with a dormant liquid: with `dormant_liquid_density`, D_V matches the hand value (rel 1e-12). Without it, the item is refused `SIZING_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE(‹item›.rho_L)`.
E01.A48 (release candidate). Every `primary` range in shipped sets is `verified: true`.
